R1 requires untranslated diagnostics for every governance Git command. D1 selects subprocess locale normalization because matching translated phrases would require maintaining Git translations. R1 is covered by direct environment assertions for both runners and the translated coordinator regression. Independently executed both successfully.

Implementation changes are limited to the environment of the two governance Git runners, regression coverage and its validation registration. Adjacent non-governance runners remain outside the spec's explicit scope.

Inspected subprocess construction, environment filtering, raw-history restrictions, argument handling and output bounds. The change adds fixed locale values and preserves path, authority, cancellation and diagnostic boundaries; no secret material or dependency was introduced.

One shared environment value applied at the two execution points is the smallest cohesive correction covering R1. It avoids translation tables, new abstractions and changes to unrelated runners. Reconsider if future governance commands require localized semantic stdout or another execution path bypasses these runners.
